source_row.stem: After using a safety-engineered needle device, the nurse should:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Activate the safety mechanism immediately after use, before disposal","B":"Leaving the safety mechanism unused, since activation is thought to be optional once the injection is complete","C":"Activating the safety feature only if the needle appears visibly contaminated with blood or other fluid","D":"Waiting until the end of the shift to activate the safety mechanism on a used needle device"}}
source_row.rationale: Safety-engineered needle devices should have their safety mechanism activated immediately after use and before disposal, to reduce needlestick injury risk.
